name: Tokenizer Threshold Context Engine
description: Own threshold compaction with native-style summary + preserved recent turns (default 113k); report tokensBefore/tokensAfter to host checkpoints.

thresholdTokens.label: Compaction threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.help: When local tokenizer counts reach this value, assemble returns a summary message plus preserved recent turns under the budget.

encoding.label: Tiktoken encoding
encoding.help: Local encoding loaded by js-tiktoken (default cl100k_base).

recentTurnsPreserve.label: Recent turns to preserve
recentTurnsPreserve.help: How many recent user/assistant turns to keep verbatim after the summary (native safeguard default: 3).
